news.analysis: Did anyone really think that McCaffrey was going to pick up more than 200 yards with three touchdowns for a second straight week? Obviously, the answer is no. The star RB did produce a solid game against a typically dominant defense, though, which included his 14th overall TD of the campaign. McCaffrey also crossed the 1,000-yard mark for total offense this season on Sunday night. He remains a top-shelf fantasy asset.
news.contents: Christian McCaffrey rushed for 49 yards and a touchdown on 12 carries, adding 13 yards on two receptions in Sunday's 35-10 rout of the Vikings.
news.title: Christian McCaffrey hits paydirt in Sunday night's win

news.analysis: Predictably, Samuel did not repeat his huge performance from Week 10 that saw him hit paydirt twice. First off, Mike Evans returned to his WR1 role for the 49ers, which cut into Samuel's snap share a bit. Secondly, the Vikings' defense just doesn't allow many big plays. Samuel is still a major role player for the 49ers' potent attack, though. He maintains his big-play, WR3 potential going forward.
news.contents: Deebo Samuel Sr. caught 3-of-4 passes for 20 yards and rushed for 27 yards on two attempts in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
